chunks: What was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin, from his brother al-Husayn, from his father Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
I asked Aba al-Hasan عليه السلام about the nafilah that is performed on Friday: is it better before the Jumu'ah or after it? He said: Before the salat.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: the prayer, here referring to the Friday salat
key_terms.بَعْدَهَا: after it, meaning after the Friday prayer
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ: Friday, the day on which this ruling applies

ai.seo_question: Is the Friday nafilah better before Jumu'ah or after it?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling on the timing of the Friday supererogatory prayer. Imam Aba al-Hasan عليه السلام states that performing the nafilah before the Friday salat is more virtuous. It is significant in discussions of prayer rulings and the recommended acts connected to Yawm al-Jumu'ah.
